'''Anthony Massung''' (also published as '''Tony Massung'''; DeckTech handle '''pSycHOjOkeR''') played the [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2014-Alderaan-Regionals.pdf 2014 Alderaan Regionals], starwarsccg.org</ref> As Tony Massung he played the [[April 2001 Pleasanton tournament (7 April)]] in California and posted a [[Dark]] [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)|5th Marker]] list on DeckTech in January 2002.<ref name="dt-20943">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20943 AT-ATs on Hoth Version 2], DeckTech (Tony "pSycHOjOkeR" Massung, 28 January 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/20943/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/20943/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
